wood.description: Illustrated hand-painted seamless wood, same pixels as approved working master; not an upscale.

patina.description: Restrained original-reference rust flecks and broken fine abrasions, no smoky stains or broad perimeter shading. Non-repeating straight-alpha layer below controls and reel.
